name: Swish Sports
tagline: Create, find and join pickup games — from casual hoops to pickleball round robins
role: Feature development for a US sports app

scenes.title: Pickup sports, organized
scenes.body: Find a game nearby, host your own, or keep a private group's games out of the group chat.

scenes.title: Find games on a live map
scenes.body: Pins show each game's start time and open spots, so a nearby run is one tap away.

scenes.title: Host a game in a few steps
scenes.body: Pick a sport, venue, date and time. Pickleball adds round robin, king-of-the-court and ladder formats.

scenes.title: Every game gets its own hub
scenes.body: Scan-to-join QR code, a waitlist when spots fill, text invites and a game feed.

scenes.title: Profiles that track your play
scenes.body: Friends, favorite sports and a running count of games this week, this month and overall.
